statement: Nvidia more than halved the number of Asian customers authorised to buy its AI chips under a new compliance whitelist.
why: Removing over half of prior Asian customers, particularly neo-clouds, tightens Nvidia's authorised sales channel and raises export-control exposure.

impact.mechanism: Whitelist removal cuts authorised buyers in Singapore, Malaysia and Japan, constraining near-term addressable GPU demand.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance (Reuters wire, citing Financial Times)
evidence.excerpt: more than halved the number of Asian customers authorised to buy its AI chips

confidence.basis: Secondary wire report of an FT story; no primary filing or exposure figures.
